Open os_inv and its semaphore invariant to obtain store_dll at k_sem_list. Extract dll_nodes_nonzero from that store_dll, using list induction if necessary, under the unchanged InsideCritical and SemaphoreZero frame. No pointer arithmetic axiom is needed.
Open os_inv and semaphore_inv only to extract semaphore_context (os_semaphore_stable sg). Frame all spatial resources; no existential target.
Extract os_world_wf sg locked from os_inv. The state is exactly locked throughout; do not substitute before for locked.
Open SemaphoreZero and its aligned storage constituents to obtain addr_aligned sem 4. Keep os_inv and InsideCritical as frames.

Unfold os_inv, semaphore_inv and SemaphoreZero. Instantiate their existing witnesses, expose the listed task/tick/delay/assign/scheduling/object invariants, store_idmanager, store_dll, ZeroIdNode, value 0, two NodeZero predicates and padding. Cancel/reorder these exact resources; no new state or ownership is introduced.

Show semaphore_manager of the published list equals the link/add expression using minimum-free-id. Rebuild os_world_wf for the published state from old wf, freshness, free id and empty pending queue; all non-semaphore state projections remain locked. Frame InsideCritical sg locked, whose state stays locked until unlock.
